answer: Price identity by making the bond non-refundable UNTIL a cooldown of honest epochs elapses — capital frozen in a tundra, not posted and reclaimed same-day. A farmer spinning a whisper of short-lived fakes can never recover the stake before abandoning them, so each throwaway identity is a total loss; the honest agent who stays recovers it through the inlet of time. Churn itself becomes the tax farms cannot dodge.
